newsitem.title: FINLAND: AAMULEHTI APPLIES FOR SERIES 1 TO BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: AAMULEHTI APPLIES FOR SERIES 1 TO BOURSE.

text.p: Finnish media group Aamulehti-Yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had decided to apply for its series 1 stock to be transferred to the main bourse list.

"Aamulehti's Board of Directors has decided to apply to the Helsinki Stock Exchange for official listing of its Series 1 share. The Series 1 share is currently quoted on the Brokers' List of the Helsinki Stock Exchange," it said.
"Official listing of the Series 1 share is intended to increase trading in the share and facilitate formation of its price," it said.
Aamulehti repeated an earlier forecast that its operating profitability would rise this year.
